items.t: Harsh or erratic shifting from a faulty engine computer
items.note: Toyota's old ECM coverage has ended. If the transmission was damaged, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Toyota's old ZE7 coverage has mostly ended; ask a dealer anyway. A used engine can cost less.

items.t: Clunk or knock when turning the steering wheel
Rear suspension arm can rust and separate
items.job: Replace both rear lower suspension arms
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN. Price is for both sides.

items.t: Accelerator can be trapped by the floor mat
items.job: Modify or replace accelerator pedal and fit correct mats
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Sticky accelerator pedal
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Driver power window switch can overheat
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Airbag light from a damaged steering wheel cable
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may deploy unexpectedly
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Rear outer seat belts can be cut in a crash
items.job: Install protective covers on rear seat frames
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Toyota dealer before paying.

items.t: Torque converter shudder
items.note: Toyota's ZH1 coverage may apply. Check your VIN with a dealer before paying.

items.t: 12V battery can shift and short, risking fire
items.job: Replace battery tray, hold-down and terminal cover
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN. Use the correct size battery.

items.t: Hesitation and lurching at low speed
items.note: Often free while under Toyota's powertrain warranty.

items.t: Coolant loss and overheating
items.job: Pressure-test cooling system and repair the leak
items.note: Cost rises a lot if overheating damaged the engine.

items.t: Front lower control arm can crack
items.job: Replace both front lower control arms
items.note: Covered by the recall. Check your VIN. Price is for both sides.

items.t: Fuel tank will not fill completely
items.job: Replace fuel tank assembly per Toyota bulletin
items.note: Toyota offered a customer support program for this. Ask a dealer before paying.

items.t: Corroded high-voltage cable under the floor
items.job: Replace high-voltage cable under the floor
items.note: Toyota extended cable coverage on many 2019-2022 hybrids. Ask a dealer before paying.

items.t: Theft-deterrent wiring connector can fail (recall 98V-278)
items.note: Was free under recall 98V-278. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall 15V-284)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-284. Do not drive until repaired. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake actuator seal fault can disable the stability system (recall 16V-198)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-198. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Spare tire may be under-inflated from the factory (recall 17V-295)
items.job: Inspect and inflate the temporary spare
items.note: Free under recall 17V-295. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water in the steering gearbox can cut power assist (recall 20V-373)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-373. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Reverse camera can stop showing a picture (recall 19V-576)
items.job: Replace camera connector and display unit
items.note: Free under recall 19V-576. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger occupant sensor short can switch off that airbag (recall 23V-865)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-865. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering column breakaway pins may be damaged (recall 20V-734)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-734. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat can confuse the airbag occupant sensor (recall 22V-519)
items.job: Repair seat and recalibrate occupant sensor
items.note: Free under recall 22V-519. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Reverse camera image can freeze or go blank (recall 25V-744)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-744. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument display may hide speed and warning lights at startup (recall 25V-595)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-595. Plug-in models may need a new cluster.

items.t: Brake caliper and hub bolts can be loose (recall 24V-911)
items.job: Inspect and torque caliper and hub bolts
items.note: Free under recall 24V-911. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat bracket welds may be weak (recall 26V-256)
items.job: Inspect and repair front seat frame bracket
items.note: Free under recall 26V-256. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Accessory wheels may have damaged tire valves (recall 23V-485)
items.job: Replace tire valve stems and load label
items.note: Free under recall 23V-485. Check the VIN first.
